The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c054f7856b32267e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 33-34. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. statement: Consider the four-change open-cap law and any sequence of switch-revealing stopping rules before completion of its strand. Let An be events determined by the stopped history. Suppose that, on An, there are basepoints zn and constants r0, α0 > 0, independent of n and of the history, such that 33 1. B(zn, r0) ⊂ Un; 2. in the conformal disk chart normalized at zn, the four current prime-end marks, including the tip, have pairwise distance at least α0 on the unit circle. Assume also that the stopped prefixes form a tight family in the oriented-curve topology, as in Proposition 6.4. Write Fn for the stopped information, EP for the primal pairing, and χUn for the ordered cross-ratio of the four current marks. Then, for every t > 0, Popen (An ∩ {|Popen(EP | Fn) − f(χUn )| > t}) −→ 0. (7.1) The basepoints may be selected from the history. The original domains lie in a fixed bounded set, so every deterministic sequence of these basepoints has a convergent subsequence.
